document: full review article (Nature Reviews / Chem Rev / Adv Mater / Nat Electron style)
skeleton: Introduction (context, technical gap, literature gap vs named reviews, scope, contribution)
Evaluation criteria and figures of merit
Body sections along a hierarchy or causal chain of the field (e.g. mechanism -> component -> system -> application)
Applications: property -> function -> best demonstration -> comparator -> next decisive result
Outlook mirroring the body with quantified targets
must_have: abstract stating the review's main finding as a claim (a synthesised number only when the body supports it)
original benchmark figure with stated normalisation
table with condition and scope columns
review voice: the field's progress told through key works (problem -> idea -> realisation -> result); no screening or counting narrative
subsection endings: synthesis or design implication plus a forward bridge; at most one numbered ending
comparison tables with a generated Year column, cited once and not restated in the text

style.attribution: concept, mechanism or claim as the grammatical subject of the topic sentence, citation at the end of the clause; key works introduced with lead authors and year ('In 2024, A, B and colleagues reported ... [3]', then 'The same team ...'); reference-as-subject ('[3] reported') only where the venue uses it; one convention throughout (see references/review-architecture.md)

basis: typical ranges for full reviews in Nature Reviews, Chemical Reviews, Advanced Materials and similar journals; take the binding limits from the target journal's author guide and two or three recent reviews in that journal
